GF-R4.notes: There are so many better heroes out there. Yes it has an attack to gain 2000 defense, but with 3k attack he's not killing anyone without substantial cards and with only 4k base defense, people can still deal double damage to him with a couple of attack boosting cards.

GW-U6.notes: For only three spirit energy, this card can, without fail, remove an opponents ability to play game winners and win-cons from an opponents deck.

DT-C100.notes: Drawing your fifth character is extremely important, as not having it out when the fifth match starts can mean you instantly lose the game. This card provides card advantage in the form of it being a free card to get your fifth player out, while also removing itself from the card pool and letting you get to the other important cards faster. It also is an item, which may synergize well with cards that benefit from items.
